Frankendancer setup, build, update, run, and network requirements guide

# Purpose
This guide explains how to install, build, configure, and run the Frankendancer validator, which combines Firedancer and Agave components in one validator process set. It defines the hardware and Linux software requirements, the source build steps, release version rules, and the `fdctl` commands used to prepare the host and start the validator. The file also gives a sample `config.toml` that sets the runtime user, gossip entrypoints, consensus keys, RPC access, and metrics reporting for a Testnet deployment. It documents the permission model and the `AF_XDP` networking setup so operators can prepare the system and run the validator with the correct privileges and network interface support.
